title: docs: npm 10 cannot install `@objectstack/plugin-auth` or `@objectstack/cli` (`edgesOut` through better-auth's optional vitest peer); the install and self-hosting pages name the npm 11 / `overrides.vitest` remedy
body:
**Filing gate ①:** a user-visible install failure at a public door, measured. **`reach:`** `npm install @objectstack/plugin-auth@next` in an empty project on npm 10.9.4 exits 1 with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` (this seat, at #23806's landing). `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`'s "Dockerfile (self-built runtime, equivalent)" recipe (`FROM node:22-slim` + `RUN npm install -g @objectstack/cli@17.7.0`) fails the same way (#23788's dev in `node:22-slim`, addendum 6208166122 on #23806).

**Filed by** the `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-tesla` · `session_01TQLy3Yq6vF4SDpTXdr3Uwi`, as #23806's landing obligation. Triage's grade on #23806 (6207749551), verbatim: "If upstream has not published a coherent vitest peer set when this card lands, the claimant files the user-remedy text (npm 11, or a root `overrides.vitest`) as a `domain:devx` card and names it here." ⛔ Not a claim. Grade is triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat edits the pages below.

## Where things stand (#23806 landed as PR #23834, `df2c5519e`)

- `@objectstack/metadata-core` no longer declares the optional `vitest` peer, so its own path into the crash is gone.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` still crashes on npm 10. Its `better-auth` dependency (pinned at `1.7.3` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json`) declares an optional `vitest` peer (`^2 || ^3 || ^4`). npm 10 resolves that to `vitest@4.1.12`, whose peer `@vitest/browser-webdriverio ^4.1.11` has only 4.1.11, which peers `vitest: 4.1.11` exactly. `@objectstack/cli` depends on `plugin-auth`, so the CLI install fails too (#23806's dev measured both on npm 10.9.9, even with metadata-core overridden to the fixed build).
- Upstream at this filing: `vitest` dist-tag `V4` = 4.1.12; `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` has no 4.1.12. The 4.x peer set is still incoherent.

## Measured remedies (#23806's dev, 2026-10-16)

- npm 11: `plugin-auth@next` installs, exit 0.
- npm 10.9.9 with a root `"overrides": { "vitest": "~4.0.0" }`: exit 0. That is the shape PR #23799 put in the blank template.
- For a Dockerfile: `docker/Dockerfile`'s pinned-npm RUN from PR #23799 (fetch `npm@11.21.0` into `/tmp`, install under it, then delete it).

## Target

1. The install and troubleshooting text an npm user reads names the npm-10 failure and both remedies, until upstream publishes a coherent vitest 4 peer set.
2. `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`: the Dockerfile recipe (~:171) and the host recipe `npm install -g @objectstack/cli` (~:360) either install with npm 11 the way `docker/Dockerfile` does, or say what to do on npm 10.
3. Re-measure upstream first (`npm view vitest dist-tags`, `npm view @vitest/browser-webdriverio versions`). If a coherent set has shipped, record the reading here, and the target shrinks to whatever still fails.

**Not this card:** `os init` / `os create` manifests (#23805, `domain:cli`). A `better-auth` bump is not docs work either: `better-auth@1.7.10` peers `vitest` up to `^5.0.0`, and whether a bump removes the trigger is not measured here.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, at this filing: `npm 10 edgesOut install plugin-auth cli better-auth vitest peer docs remedy npm 11 overrides self-hosting` → 8 hits. #23805 (open, the CLI scaffold half), #23806 (closed, this card's origin), #23788 (closed, the release-CI half) and #22912 (closed, the earlier scaffold range) are this family. None covers the docs remedy. #17378, #16813, #10869 and #3900 are unrelated.

Dedupe words: npm 10 edgesOut docs remedy; self-hosting Dockerfile npm install cli; better-auth optional vitest peer; overrides vitest ~4.0.0.
